scope: Dark isothermal native HOMO-to-LUMO pair creation versus one midpoint defect; exploratory, not material fit
energy_convention: relaxed minima including static renormalization; all energies eV
distance_control: H(r)=10 micro-eV * exp[-(r-5 nm)/a]; no budget renormalization
bath_DOS: Each normalized uniform one-sided band of width 1 eV; same endpoints as the graph, no extra spatial drop

nuclear_kernel.thermal_sidebands: all integer indices; prior audited implementation

common_bath_displacement_gram: Gii=1, Gij=0.5 in each spectral sector; explicit common-plus-local construction
main_mu: muL=+F/2 eV; muR=-F/2 eV at fixed 10 nm span
conditional_density_name: Npair effective independent available native orbital-pair graphs; never Nt for direct model
conditional_J: q*Npair*d*R only if independent uniformly available graphs and complete collection
parameter_evidence: All microscopic numbers are shared legacy exploratory choices, not experimental D18:L8-BO parameters. No effective mass or fitted field threshold is introduced.
